01: Three AI agents debate a failed $42 renewal. Money moves only on their consensus, and every decision is hashed into the payment itself.
02: Give the agents a category and a budget. Channel3 finds real products; the Tribunal judges each. Nothing is bought until two agree.
03: A $90 purchase against a $60 budget: the Auditor and Witness block it. The dissent map names who refused; the ledger keeps the proof.
04: A $42 renewal comes back CONDITIONAL. The agents only propose — PayPal hands a human the approval link, and money moves after that tap.
05: One bar per agent vote on the Bryntum timeline: green approved, red blocked, blue neutral. Open disputes stay flagged like a triage board.
06: Every decision, every vote, every receipt in one AG Grid dashboard. Each row carries the hash stamped into the PayPal order.
07: Three runnable claims in the page: the whole suite (135 passed, 0 failed), a live verdict grid, and a receipt re-hashed against PayPal.
08: The 4x4 verdict grid, reproduced live: sixteen adjudications computed on the button. Spend part of the month and every cell turns stricter.
